FIRST_NAME.HINT: Needs at least 1 character and under 40 characters.

LAST_NAME.HINT: Needs at least 1 character and under 40 characters.

EMAIL.HINT: Email should be in the format xxxxxxx@xxxxx.xxx.

TELEPHONE.HINT: Expected to begin with 07 or +44, and be 10-11 characters.

PASSWORD.HINT: Expects between 8 and 50 characters, 1 upper case, 1 number and special character.
